  20 ## Gameplay Actor Asset Rows
  21 
  22 Only the final three SpriteFrames bundles are actor rows. Heroine actions: idle/run/jump/attack/cast/dodge/hurt. Dealer actions: idle/move/melee_attack/cast. Boss actions: idle/attack. The producer resolves cadence, counts, durations and source batches through the character-bundle contract. Animation requires genuinely distinct generated body poses, consistent feet origin and live frame advancement. Fall may reuse jump; death may use hurt plus scene treatment; dealer hurt may flash. The rigid flying-card enemy intentionally uses enemy_card with movement/flip. No large portrait slot is approved.

 121 ## Post-Processing Notes
 122 
 123 - Process only actual provider/user source images using the controlled family tools; preserve sources and provenance. No placeholder or ad hoc drawn replacement for missing art.
 124 - Validate exact Godot resource types, frame inventory, dimensions, transparency, slot names, pivots, seams and runtime scale before registration.
 125 - The font source exists; destination remains MISSING until copied and verified. A documented fontTools subset is permitted by PLAN only if every binding/manifest path is updated and all displayed Chinese glyphs survive.
 126 - Asset readiness does not prove scene composition, animation at runtime, native/Web play, or browser persistence; those require implementation and current captures.

 128 ## Verified Runtime Binding Measurements
 129 
 130 These measurements describe verified output geometry; the binding code must account for transparent padding rather than scaling the entire padded canvas to the desired actor height.
 131 
 132 - heroine_frames: 256 px canvas; idle visible body median 202 px. Use approximately 0.49 scale for a 100 px body. Centered sprite offsets before scale: y=-105 for idle/run/jump/attack/dodge, -102 for cast, -106 for hurt. These compensate measured baseline y=233/230/234 respectively; minor per-frame one-pixel variation remains subject to runtime visual review.
 133 - dealer_frames: 256 px canvas, approximately 110 px visible body at scale 1.0. Centered sprite y offsets: idle/move -54, melee_attack -88, cast -56. Preserve these action-specific padding offsets; do not rescale all frames per action.
 134 - boss_frames: 512 px canvas, idle body approximately 270 px at scale 1.0. Centered sprite y offsets: idle -136, attack -186. Attack release frame index 3 occurs at 0.35 seconds; attack ends at 0.7 seconds. The original padding difference is compensated in presentation binding, not hidden as a common-canvas-origin claim.
 135 - casino_platforms: joining walk edge is y=6 in every 160×80 texture cell. Draw image top at collision top minus 6 px. Closed cap ornaments reach y=4; these are a 2 px cosmetic overhang, not an extra collision ledge.
 136 - ui_cjk_font: native FontFile loading and all 65 distinct Chinese characters in current GDD/SCENES passed. The supplied TTC defaults to Noto Sans CJK JP; browser glyph rendering still requires actual Web verification.
